clue.text: Drive Earl in California? That's sweet!

indicators.note: the word in tells us the drive and the earl sit inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: CAL is a common abbreviation for the state of California
to drive is to ram, as when forcing something home

explanation.surface: A car journey through California, with an aristocrat aboard, is declared a lovely treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A chewy toffee-like confection is a sweet, so the exclamation points to one.

clue.text: Revive space traveller with oxygen

parts.note: a comet is a body that travels through space
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: An astronaut is brought round with an oxygen supply.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover consciousness after fainting is a phrasal-verb synonym for revive.

clue.text: Interest in soldiers' act

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of British soldiers
a turn is an act or routine in a variety show

explanation.surface: Someone takes an interest in what the troops are doing.
explanation.definitionFit: Interest earned on money is the yield or profit an investment brings back, a financial sense of the word.

clue.text: Mail centre becomes profit oriented

indicators.note: becomes signals that the letters of mail centre turn into something new when rearranged

explanation.surface: A postal sorting office is turned into a money-making business.
explanation.definitionFit: Commerce-minded and focused on trade and gain, the adjective describes a profit-seeking outlook.

clue.text: Money leads Charlie into temptation

indicators.note: into places the letter for Charlie within the word meaning temptation

parts.note: a lure is an enticement or temptation
C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Cash is what draws a man called Charlie astray.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy lucre is a disparaging term for cash, so the word is a synonym for money.

clue.text: Doctor married lover

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with or alter, so the letters of married are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wedded physician has a secret sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor or fan who adores someone is a lover in the sense of an enthusiastic follower.

clue.text: A maiden was not accustomed to hold me for pleasure

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

indicators.note: to hold means the dated contraction wraps around the word me

parts.note: usen't is an old contraction of used not, meaning was not accustomed
taken as written

explanation.surface: A young woman, unused to it, is asked to embrace the speaker for fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hold' is the container signal. The contraction for 'was not accustomed' is a rare, dated form most solvers will not know, which makes this clue harder than its surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Enjoyment or entertainment is a near synonym of pleasure.

clue.text: Silencer Mike put on Victorian pick-up

indicators.note: in a down clue, put on means the first letter sits above the vehicle

parts.note: M is Mike in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a ute is an Australian utility vehicle or pick-up truck; Victoria is an Australian state

explanation.surface: A man called Mike places a silencer on an old nineteenth-century record player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victorian' suggests the 1800s but means the Australian state, where a pick-up truck is a ute.
explanation.definitionFit: A damper fitted to an instrument to soften its sound is a silencer of sorts.

clue.text: Poet has single girl introduced to mountain climbing

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means reading upwards, so the combined piece is reversed
introduced to means the girl's name is placed inside the hill

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or peak
Tess is a girl's name
I is the Roman numeral one, a single

explanation.surface: A poet's work features an unmarried girl brought along on a mountaineering trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduced to' places the girl inside the hill, and 'climbing' turns the result upwards (ROSSETT), as a down clue reads from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Christina and Dante Gabriel Rossetti were both Victorian poets, so the name is an example of a poet.

clue.text: Become exhausted, like a narrowly-beaten cricket team

definitions.meaning: to have supplies dwindle, to fail to have enough left
a side that loses by a few runs ended a little below the target score

explanation.surface: Tiredness overtakes a cricket side that lost by a whisker.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplies that become exhausted have dwindled; a team losing narrowly fell a few runs below its target.

clue.text: Travel a short time to a river

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a brief time

explanation.surface: A quick trip down to the riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive along in a car is to travel by road, a verb sense of the word.

clue.text: Mistress recounts a disaster

indicators.note: a disaster reduces things to a mess, so the letters of recounts a are scrambled

explanation.surface: A kept woman tells the tale of a calamity.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman kept by a wealthy lover, historically at court, is a mistress.

clue.text: Yarn about Lawrence having opponents browbeaten

indicators.note: about means the yarn goes around the other two pieces

parts.note: a thread is a yarn
T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia, gives his initials TE
in bridge, North and East are opposing players, NE

explanation.surface: A story about Lawrence facing enemies who bullied him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yarn' looks like a story but is a literal thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone browbeaten has been intimidated, made to feel menaced, which is the participle's sense.

clue.text: Engagement revealed in game show

indicators.note: revealed in shows the letters are found inside game show

explanation.surface: A betrothal is announced on a television quiz programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engagement' suggests a betrothal but means gears interlocking.
explanation.definitionFit: When gear teeth interlock they engage with each other, so engagement is the noun for that action.

clue.text: Know Carol's not up in London

parts.note: ken is a Scots word meaning to know
to carol is to sing

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word not reads from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Someone recognises that Carol is out of bed and about in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Kensington is a district of west London, so the definition names where it lies.

clue.text: Scrap dealer keeps Ethel confused? Exactly!

indicators.note: keeps means the dealer holds the jumbled name inside

parts.note: a totter is a rag-and-bone man, who collects scrap

indicators.note: confused means the letters of Ethel are mixed up

explanation.surface: A junk collector is holding on to a bewildered woman called Ethel.
explanation.walkthrough: A TOTTER is British slang for a rag-and-bone man collecting scrap; 'confused' gives HELET from Ethel.
explanation.definitionFit: Following instructions precisely, down to the last detail, is an idiom for exactly.

clue.text: Drunken tackle keeps player well connected

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk

indicators.note: keeps means the gear surrounds the player's letter

parts.note: kit is equipment, tackle
N, North, is a player at bridge

explanation.surface: An inebriated sports team's equipment holds on to a player who is well connected.
explanation.definitionFit: A close community whose members are strongly bonded is closely linked, well connected.

clue.text: Society awaiting settlement of expenses

parts.note: pending means not yet decided, awaiting settlement

explanation.surface: A club has its costs waiting to be paid.
explanation.definitionFit: Outlay of money is spending, a noun close in sense to expenses.

clue.text: Brother stores silver tubing for musician

indicators.note: stores means the abbreviation for brother holds the other pieces

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a pipe is a length of tubing

explanation.surface: A monk keeps silver piping intended for a player.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of the Highland pipes is one kind of musician.

clue.text: Place of judgement where Penny advanced tycoon

parts.note: early means advanced, ahead of time
Bill Gates, founder of Microsoft, is a famous tycoon

explanation.surface: A courtroom where a woman named Penny pushed forward a rich businessman.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Peter is said to judge souls at the entrance to heaven, so it is a place of judgement.

clue.text: Small child gets spectacles for motor vehicle

parts.note: a kid is a child
OO looks like a pair of glasses

explanation.surface: A little youngster is given glasses before riding in a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorised snow sled is a kind of motor vehicle.

clue.text: Inventor in side-on crash

indicators.note: a crash smashes things up, so the letters of side-on are rearranged

explanation.surface: An inventor is caught up in a broadside collision.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Alva Edison devised the phonograph and a practical light bulb, a famous example of an inventor.

clue.text: Pinches small quantities of booze

definitions.meaning: squeezes sharply between finger and thumb
drams or small measures of spirits

explanation.surface: Someone takes little nips of alcohol on the sly.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinch is a nip, and a small drink of spirits is also a nip.

clue.text: Uncovered bet about old vessel reaching pole

indicators.note: about means the wager goes around the vessel and the pole

parts.note: staked means bet, as money wagered
the ark is Noah's ancient vessel
N, north, is a magnetic pole

explanation.surface: A wager concerning an ancient ship arriving at the Pole is exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing nothing at all is to be completely bare, uncovered.

clue.text: Rushes about with English detective

parts.note: re means about, concerning
DS is a Detective Sergeant

explanation.surface: A man hurries around with an English sleuth.
explanation.definitionFit: Rushes and reeds are both tall marsh plants, so the plural nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Sovereign tucked into fish in lounge

indicators.note: tucked into means the coin's letter is placed inside the fish

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish
a sovereign is a pound coin, and L is the pound sign's letter

explanation.surface: A monarch is enjoying a fish supper in the living room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sovereign' suggests a monarch but is the gold pound coin, giving L (from libra).
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf or laze about is to lounge, a verb sense.

clue.text: Thoughtlessness right away leads to rudeness

indicators.note: away means the letter for right is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: imprudence is rashness, thoughtlessness

explanation.surface: Carelessness, with good manners abandoned, ends in insolence.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheek and insolence are synonyms for rudeness.

clue.text: Head of security to check back for trends

indicators.note: back means the verb meaning to check is read in reverse

parts.note: to edit is to check copy

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of security is taken

explanation.surface: The security chief must keep checking the latest fashions.
explanation.definitionFit: General drifts of opinion are tides, a figurative sense close to trends.

clue.text: Man with weapon hidden in clothing

indicators.note: hidden in means the weapon is placed inside the word for man

parts.note: a gent is a man
an arm is a weapon

explanation.surface: A man conceals a gun in his clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: An item of clothing is a garment, so the singular serves for the general word.

clue.text: Time of day for loose women in Senegal

indicators.note: in means the unfastening and the women's letter sit inside the country code

parts.note: SN is the international code for Senegal
to undo is to loosen

explanation.surface: Evening is when women of easy virtue appear on the streets of Senegal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loose women' suggests promiscuity, but loose is the verb UNDO and women just W.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunset, when the sun goes down, is a particular time of day.
